# Inception Flap Scanner
> Real-time on-chain token launch screener, bonding curve telemetry tracker, and 4-tier security auditor on BNB Smart Chain.

## Canonical Resources
- Web Application: https://lucace-inception-flap-scanner.hf.space
- GitHub: https://github.com/arbincept/inception-flap-scanner
- Ecosystem Directories: Awesome-Web3 (PR #795), OffcierCia On-Chain Investigations (PR #46)
- License: MIT License

## Technical Specifications
- Blockchain Network: BNB Smart Chain (BSC, Chain ID: 56)
- Target Bonding Curve: Flap.sh on-chain curve metrics & progress telemetry
- Security Auditing Pipeline:
  1. ERC-1167 minimal proxy bytecode verification (detecting custom architectural deviations)
  2. Predatory tax filtering (strictly flags tokens with >8% transfer tax)
  3. Phishing and duplicate social handle detection
  4. Developer funding wallet clustering heuristics
- Tech Stack: Node.js 22, Vite, React 19, Ethers.js v6, Docker on Hugging Face Spaces SDK
- Official Contacts: luca.celebrano1@gmail.com | Telegram: https://t.me/ArbitrageInception
